statement: The real numbers $a,b,c$ with $bc\neq 0$ satisfy $\dfrac{1-c^2}{bc}\geq 0$. Prove that $10(a^2+b^2+c^2-bc^3)\geq 2ab+5ac$.

A student read advanced mathematics for 37 days according to: (a) at least one hour every day, (b) an integer number of hours, at most 12, each day, (c) at most 60 hours in total. Prove that there were some successive days during which the student read exactly 13 hours in total.

In a triangle $ABC$ we have $\angle C>100^\circ$ and $\angle B=\angle C+10^\circ$. Point $E$ on side $AB$ satisfies $\angle ACE=10^\circ$, and point $D$ on side $AC$ satisfies $\angle DBA=15^\circ$. Let $Z\neq A$ be a point of intersection of the circumcircles of triangles $ABD$ and $AEC$. Prove that $\angle ZBA>\angle ZCA$.

(a) Positive integers $p,q,r,a$ satisfy $pq=ra^2$, where $r$ is prime and $p,q$ are relatively prime. Prove that one of $p,q$ is a perfect square.\n(b) Examine if there exists a prime $p$ such that $p(2^{p+1}-1)$ is a perfect square.
